canonical_claim: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, A an abelian variety over k, and X a closed subvariety of A. If torsion points of A lying on X are Zariski dense in X, then X is a finite union of translates of abelian subvarieties of A by torsion points.
domain_and_universes: An algebraically closed characteristic-zero field k; an abelian variety A/k; a closed subvariety X of A.
hypotheses: torsion points of A contained in X are Zariski dense in X
conclusion: X is a finite union of torsion translates of abelian subvarieties of A
